authoritativeOrigin: Design parameter IDs + Design Notes and Engineering Guide in web.html (main baseline)
method: Curated paraphrased engineering implications; review vendor release before production use; not live RAG; no raw RFC text stored

sources.title: Cisco Catalyst 9300 IOS XE 17.15 Configuring VTP

records.context: Core-1/Core-2 primary-secondary intent: lower priority is preferred for each VLAN. Bridge ID includes MAC; no live root election proof from configuration.
records.analysis: Compare both cores and relevant VLAN instances once; discuss preferred root, standby behavior and intended active/standby versus VLAN load distribution.

records.context: Dual-attached access links in standalone STP create standby path capacity, not active-active multichassis LAG. Root/link failure requires topology recalculation.
records.analysis: Evaluate topology path redundancy, designated/alternate ports and fault-domain assumptions. Never infer measured failover speed.

records.context: RSTP speeds eligible link transitions; MST region name, revision and VLAN-to-instance map must match to remain in same region; CIST still governs boundary paths.
records.analysis: Compare protocol modes and MST parameters across nodes and interpret interoperability and CIST boundary implications.

records.context: PortFast/edge fast forwarding is intended for true endpoints, not inter-switch redundancy. The actual port role must be known.
records.analysis: Flag PortFast placement only where interface role is known and contradictory; absence in running config is not necessarily disablement.

records.context: BPDU Guard on endpoint edge ports protects against receiving unexpected BPDUs by moving ports into an error-disabled/inconsistent status depending on platform implementation.
records.analysis: Check deployment on edge ports and protection against accidental switch connections, without implying it belongs on core trunks.

records.context: Root Guard on downstream designated-facing links prevents a leaf from becoming root after superior BPDUs; do not place on a root port.
records.analysis: Check the actual interface's STP role before recommending changes; root-inconsistent state requires show evidence.

records.context: Loop Guard protects eligible redundant links when expected BPDUs disappear, helping prevent unexpected forwarding transitions.
records.analysis: Evaluate Loop Guard only on eligible network-side ports and in context with Root Guard and neighbor roles.

records.context: UDLD aggressive can detect unidirectional links; support varies by fiber, transceiver and vendor.
records.analysis: Check uplink media, directionality, feature availability and operational UDLD status.

records.context: Off means locally managed VLANs without forwarding VTP advertisements; transparent locally manages VLANs but may forward received VTPv2/v3 advertisements; VTPv3 server/client can synchronize database with primary-server administration.
records.analysis: Compare both Core VTP modes/domain/version and local VLAN inventory. For server/client, absent authentication evidence is a high-priority verification gap, not proof password is absent; confirmed no authentication merits critical severity.
verification: show vtp password (presence only; never disclose value)

records.context: Native VLAN determines handling of untagged traffic on 802.1Q trunks. VLAN 999 configured as an ordinary VLAN is not evidence it is native; only switchport trunk native vlan or operational output establishes intent.
records.analysis: Compare mapped trunk endpoints and VLAN membership; use context-dependent VLAN hopping and tagging risks, not blanket exploitation claims.

records.context: Allowed VLAN list on trunks must include required user, management and services but avoid unnecessary broadcast/unknown-unicast domains.
records.analysis: Compare VLAN scope on both dual-home paths and ensure pruning is service-aware.

records.context: DTP negotiates trunk mode where enabled. Static trunk plus nonegotiate can reduce unintended negotiation exposure when neighbor settings are coordinated.
records.analysis: Evaluate dynamically negotiated access-facing links and whether switchport nonegotiate is supported and correct.

records.context: A Port-channel must terminate on one logical peer; standalone independent cores cannot be treated like a single multi-chassis LAG. StackWise Virtual forms one logical bridge and uses MEC.
records.analysis: Contrast standalone Core pair, LACP and StackWise Virtual; check bundle consistency and the root topology.

records.context: BRIDGE-MIB in RFC 4188 exposes dot1dStpDesignatedRoot/dot1dStpRootPort/dot1dStpTopChanges; RSTP-MIB in RFC 4318 exposes edge and point-to-point operational state; no SNMP state is observed from config alone.
records.analysis: Use RFC objects to plan read-only verification and counter-delta investigations; protect writable SNMP MIB objects with management access controls.
verification: read-only BRIDGE-MIB / RSTP-MIB SNMP where supported

records.context: RFC 7727 specifies STP application TLVs for ICCP Provider Edge redundancy groups serving multihomed STP/VPLS. Do not map generic vPC/MLAG or standalone campus pair to ICCP without explicit evidence.
records.analysis: Only evaluate virtual-root and ICCP STP sync on confirmed ICCP Provider Edge groups.
verification: Verify device redundancy architecture and ICCP STP application support
